name: Drake Blakeley
original_name: ドレイク・ブレークリー
source:
[i]"Monsters need no motive."[/i]

[i]Bigoted Justice[/i]

A police investigator who's climbed the ranks working out in the field. His bungling nature and stubborn personality sometimes lead him to investigate on mistaken assumptions. But because he prioritizes community harmony over personal gain, his colleagues deeply trust him.

He's hostile toward the Grimnal organization Vy-xen, and is just as suspicious of the government that has sanctioned them.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=drake]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
